title: OpenAPI Events — per-event speaker overrides
description: data/<year>/<slug>/speakers/speakers.yaml — point-in-time overrides layered over the global registry, typically the company a speaker worked for at that event. Same entry shape as the registry, but only `slug` is required: list just the fields that differ. Merging is per field, except list-valued fields (`badges`, `urls`) which replace the registry's list wholesale.
